sources.excerpt: Fender Fuzz Wah Pedal Regular price $199.00 Sale price $199.00 Sale Default Title Add to cart Fender probably isn't the first name you think of for outboard effects and pedals, but they starting producing effects almost as they started producing guitars and amplifiers. Introduced in 1968, the Fender Fuzz-Wah combines two of the Psychedelic Eera's defining effects into one substantial, all-metal pedal. The design is every bit as distinctive as the concept. The large treadle operates the wah with a traditional front-to-back motion, while a side-to-side movement controls the output volume. Separate footswitches engage the fuzz and wah independently, so either effect can be used on its own or both can be combined. With the effects switched off, the side-to-side movement is still in your signal chain, so the pedal functions as a volume pedal. Combining fuzz and wah may seem like a simple idea, but the approach is perhaps over-engineered.
